Angel Robotics reports Thai registration for Angel Suit H10

The walking-assistance wearable adds its third overseas registration after Malaysia and Vietnam.

Electronic Times ↗29 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

A broader Thai lineup

Electronic Times reports that Angel Robotics announced completion of Thai FDA registration for Angel Suit H10 on October 29. It is the model’s third overseas registration after Malaysia and Vietnam, complementing the Angel Legs M20 rehabilitation product already registered in Thailand.

Sensors guide assistance

H10 launched in Korea in June of the preceding year. According to the company’s description, seven high-precision sensors analyze user movement and adapt assistance. Modes include walking, sitting and standing support, as well as resistance training.

Market access and deployment differ

The company plans Southeast Asian expansion through local registrations. The report provides no Thai price, sales date or clinical results and relays the company’s announcement rather than reproducing a complete registration document. It does not establish identical treatment benefits for every user.
